{{Quote|Your mission is to infiltrate the Hammer, discover the nature of Project: Shell-cracker, and then steal the prototype. If taking it intact proves impossible, then you are to destroy it at all costs. Whatever the outcome, we cannot permit a weapon of this nature, whatever that nature might be, to remain within the hands of the Empire. Questions?|Elemack, to a team of Rebel agents|<ref name="OSG" />}}
'''Operation: Shell Game''' was a mission carried out by a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. During the mission, the agents infiltrated the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|space station]] [[HM7-R]].<ref name="OSG" />

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Operation: Shell Game appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] adventure of the [[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|same name]]. It was included in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|Beta edition]] of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]]. This article assumes the adventure plays out as described.<ref name="OSG" />
